name: Joel
overview: Joel is a male biblical figure identified as a descendant of Nebo who had married a foreign wife. There is no information about his tribe or additional notes, making his unique attribute the primary detail known about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Joel means 'YHWH is God [El],' reflecting a theophoric name that acknowledges the sovereignty of the Lord. This name is recorded in Ezra 10:43 and is a proper name not indicated as given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Joel is explicitly described as a descendant of Nebo, establishing a familial link within the biblical genealogy. Beyond this, Scripture does not record any other family relationships for him apart from his marriage to a foreign wife.
scriptureSignificance: Joel's significance lies in his identification as a descendant of Nebo who had married a foreign wife, a detail noted in Ezra 10:43. This association places him within the post-exilic community dealing with issues of intermarriage, which was a significant concern for maintaining covenant faithfulness. His mention underscores the challenges faced by the returning Israelites in preserving their distinct identity under God's covenant.
